notes.title: Patch 2018.1005 Notes (Updated to 1006)
notes.notes:
Game Fixes (thanks, folks who brought these to my attention!)

- Fixed issue with displaying career leaders (players) in a very long career
- Fixed Ineligible Man Downfield penalty (now 5 yards, no loss of down)
- Fixed display of 3-4, 4-3 preference

notes.title: Patch 2018.0923 Notes
notes.notes:
Added some enhancements:
- Now displays name of tackler/sacker (only on new matchups/games)
- Added Scout button to more Career screens
- Improved AI logic regarding going for two points

Any new games you play will display the tackler or sacker.

notes.title: Patch 2018.0905 Notes
notes.notes:
I've just released the first update for PSF 2019, based on feedback from users.

Update 2018.0905 (Sept 5, 2018)
If your career has a problem from the initial version, you should either simulate the entire current season or start with a new career.  However, I don't expect you to have any problems.

Fixes:
- several fixes to Career play when coaching or simulating individual games
- now correctly update Career History all the time
- now automatically advance to offseason when simulating super bowl
- fix display of divisions to vary by conference
- fixed OT rules for regular season and playoffs

Enhancements:
- Can now switch image sets on existing career!
- Can now switch image sets on the fly!
- Analyze Game now displays Point Spread (desktop versions)
- Default End Zones now use all caps on team name and nickname
- several cosmetic changes
